about: Class per runs/suite-* folder, checked by hand against EVALUATION.md, docs/plans/2026-11-02-modal-review.md and the run logs. eval = a Muse suite EVALUATION.md reports as a measured result; dev = Claude (development only, never a Muse result) or Muse work not reported as a result; smoke = a few runs that check a setup works; dead end = interrupted, superseded or lost to the host. demo = runs of the demo set (evals/briefs-demo.json), written for the video, not an evaluation; heldout = a run of the held-out set on the frozen agent (tag eval-final), approved by the owner (RULES.md); reported apart from development-set rates.
